body:
**Bug:** a task stored at the root project (`.`) disappears from the board when the board connects or reconnects. This happens whether or not the task has a feature. Example: *Fix: Agent - Failed to authenticate* (144dce741564c638) is in Planning, but the board doesn't show it.

**Cause:** at the end of every new stream, the server's `Events::strategy_state` (`board.rs`) sends the tasks with no project (D-129) as `{"tasks": [...], "noProject": true}`. That message has no `project` field. On the board, `solace_board.event_dir` sends a message with no `project` to the lane whose `base` is `""`, which is the root's `.` lane. `task_event` then reads its `tasks` as that lane's full task list. So the `.` lane's tasks are replaced by the no-project list, which here is empty. Later single-task events add tasks back one at a time, so only tasks that changed after the connection show.

The same thing can happen with a single `{"task": ..., "noProject": true}` on a stream that isn't merged (`Events::next_task`): it would add a no-project task to the root lane.

**Fix (board only):** the board ignores any `/events` message with `noProject: true`, both the list and a single task. These tasks are in no lane (D-129) and only the Strategy page uses them. Do this in `live` or `knows`, so held messages (`settle`) skip them too. The server and the Strategy page stay as they are.

**Test:** in `solace_board_test`, set up a workspace model with a `.` lane that holds a Planning task with no feature. Applying `{"tasks":[],"noProject":true}` leaves the task in that lane's cards. Applying `{"task":{...},"noProject":true}` adds nothing.
title: board: no-project snapshot empties the root lane
